explanation:
The flow starts at `LoginPage` (client/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx:5).

1. `LoginPage` renders `LoginForm`; navigates to `/dashboard`.
2. `LoginForm` calls `handleSubmit()` on onSubmit.
3. `handleSubmit()` calls `login()`.
4. `login()` sends `POST /api/auth/login`; checks `!response.ok` (yes → `throw Error`).
5. `POST /api/auth/login` runs middleware `loginRateLimit()` and `validateBody()`; calls `authController.login()`.
6. `loginRateLimit()` writes `redis.incr`; checks `attempts === 1` (yes → `redis.expire`); checks `attempts > MAX_ATTEMPTS` (yes → `429 Too Many Requests`).
7. `validateBody()` checks `!result.success` (yes → `400 Bad Request`).
8. `authController.login()` calls `findUserByEmail()`; checks `!user` (yes → `recordFailedLogin()`, `401 Unauthorized`; no → `verifyPassword()`, checks `!valid`).
9. `findUserByEmail()` reads `user.findUnique`.
10. `recordFailedLogin()` writes `loginAttempt.create`.
11. `verifyPassword()` calls `bcrypt.compare`.
12. If `!valid`: yes → `recordFailedLogin()`, `401 Unauthorized`; no → `createSession()`, `setSessionCookie()`, `user.loggedIn`, `toPublicUser()`.
13. `createSession()` calls `randomBytes`; writes `session.create`.
14. `user.loggedIn` triggers `on user.loggedIn handler`.
15. `on user.loggedIn handler` writes `user.update`.
